# Kotus word list of modern Finnish, version 1

The word list `tools/gen_finnish_types.py` reads into
`src/generated/finnish_types.h`: Kotimaisten kielten keskuksen
nykysuomen sanalista, version 1 (2006), exactly as published in
`kotus-sanalista_v1/` of the GitHub copy
`https://github.com/hugovk/everyfinnishword` at commit
`d4df6e4efdce54c10197cf151a5cd0638d99860a`. Kotus publishes it under the
GNU LGPL, the EUPL 1.1 and the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
licence; this library takes it under CC BY 3.0, with the attribution in
`LICENSES/CC-BY-3.0-kotus.txt`.

SHA-256 of each file:

```text
6e6350d55b1b47511e9a9e54543cee8454e016cfea51c24ec16891a8e3142a3e  kotus-sanalista_v1.xml
```
